usageRule: Reference benchmarks from our own multi-site publishing/engineering operations and standard domain formulas. Inject at most 2 matched items (~100-140 tokens) per route. Never claim hands-on third-party product testing unless basis=='measured'. Never use on clinical dosing, legal advice, sanctions, or biography routes.

benchmarks.fact: Operating roughly 30 production content and interactive-tool sites on Git-backed static/SSR deployments (Astro and Next.js) keeps recurring infrastructure near $0-$20/month per site with zero plugin-patch downtime, whereas typical small-business WordPress stacks accumulate $35-$150+/month across managed hosting, premium forms/SEO/security plugins, and recurring maintenance.
benchmarks.whenItFlips: Non-technical teams editing daily visual landing pages without Git workflows still move faster on managed builders despite higher 36-month renewal TCO.

benchmarks.fact: Across multi-model content, extraction, and verification pipelines on our ~30-site portfolio, effective cost per completed deliverable is governed by pass-1 accuracy rather than raw input token price: a budget model requiring 2-3 retry/fix passes plus long system context often costs more in total tokens and latency than a higher-rate model finishing cleanly on pass 1.
benchmarks.whenItFlips: High-volume deterministic classification, routing, or short-context extraction with <5% retry rates favors flash/mini or open-weight endpoints.

benchmarks.fact: Across our ~30-site publishing portfolio (including Layer3Labs scaling from 655 to 115,644 organic search sessions between June and September 2026), pages earning early Google clicks and AI answer citations consistently pair a concrete numeric answer in Paragraph 1, structured comparison/scenario tables in the top half, clean FAQ/Article JSON-LD, and IndexNow submission.
benchmarks.whenItFlips: Technical crawl hygiene (llms.txt, schema, IndexNow) cannot rescue commodity summaries that repeat vendor pricing pages without original math or testing.

benchmarks.fact: Drawing on managing a $200M+ consumer electronics business on Amazon (3M+ customer funnel analysis) and operating B2C marketplaces across 1.5M+ users, off-site and agent-mediated checkouts trade first-party customer email capture, bundle attach rate, and repeat LTV for top-of-funnel discovery—making take-rates painless on >55% gross-margin goods but punitive on <25% margin SKUs.
benchmarks.whenItFlips: High-margin catalog brands with strong repeat replenishment can treat external agent/marketplace checkouts as profitable new-customer acquisition.

benchmarks.fact: In practical local LLM sizing, usable model + KV-cache headroom on Apple Silicon unified memory is roughly 70%-75% of total RAM before macOS memory pressure degrades tok/s, while a single 24GB-32GB discrete GPU delivers 3x-5x faster prompt processing and token generation when the quantized weights + 8K-16K context fit completely inside VRAM.
benchmarks.whenItFlips: Below ~15-20 hours/week of active inference, cloud API pay-as-you-go ($5-$30/month) takes 3+ years to break even against a $2,000-$4,000 local rig.

benchmarks.fact: Working with HOA and condo boards across the U.S., software minimum monthly platform fees ($100-$300/month floors) punish self-managed associations under 40-50 doors ($3-$7/door/month), whereas 150+ door communities care far more about automated ACH collection, architectural tracking, and clean treasurer handoffs than per-door sticker price.
benchmarks.whenItFlips: Under 25-unit associations with <20 monthly transactions often spend less staying on bank ACH + spreadsheet reserves than adopting enterprise HOA suites.

benchmarks.fact: Standard residential trade callout minimums ($125-$225 trip/diagnostic fee before parts or hourly labor) mean sub-$60 bolt-on part swaps with zero gas, refrigerant, or main-panel exposure pay back specialty DIY tools on job one, while misdiagnosed control-board swaps quickly exceed pro service cost.
benchmarks.whenItFlips: Any repair involving sealed refrigerants, gas valves, service-panel lugs, or warranty-voiding OEM diagnostics favors licensed dispatch.

benchmarks.fact: On physical gear with recurring consumables (HEPA/carbon filters, blades, humidity packs), 3-year total ownership cost is dominated 2x-4x more by proprietary replacement intervals and per-refill pricing than Day-1 hardware sticker price.
benchmarks.whenItFlips: Occasional or travel-only use stretches replacement cycles enough that lower upfront hardware cost wins over 36 months.
